description: This file contains SQL scripts for creating views, functions, and other objects for the OE schema in an Oracle database. It includes view definitions for account managers, customers, and orders, as well as a PL/SQL function to get phone numbers. The script is meant for post-load schema setup and contains comments and references to other scripts.

methods.name: get_phone_number_f
methods.description: PL/SQL function to retrieve a phone number from a phone list array based on an input index.
